title.zh: Binance Pay让游客可在日本PayPay商户使用USDT消费
title.en: Binance Pay lets visitors spend USDT at PayPay merchants in Japan

current_state.zh: Binance Pay通过HIVEX接入日本PayPay QR支付网络，符合条件的海外访客可使用加密货币在参与商户处付款，商户收到日元；日本居民及部分商户类型被排除。
current_state.en: Binance Pay is live on Japan's PayPay QR payment network via HIVEX, enabling eligible overseas visitors to pay with crypto at participating merchants while merchants receive yen; Japan residents and certain merchant categories are excluded.

updates.title_zh: Binance Pay让游客可在日本PayPay商户使用USDT消费
updates.title_en: Binance Pay lets visitors spend USDT at PayPay merchants in Japan
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance Pay现允许用户直接在日本PayPay二维码支付网络的商户处使用USDT消费，将稳定币支付扩展至日本主流零售场景。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance Pay now allows users to spend USDT directly at merchants on Japan's PayPay QR payment network, extending stablecoin payments into mainstream Japanese retail.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance Pay现允许用户直接在日本PayPay二维码支付网络的商户处使用USDT消费，将稳定币支付扩展至日本主流零售场景。
updates.current_state_en: Binance Pay now allows users to spend USDT directly at merchants on Japan's PayPay QR payment network, extending stablecoin payments into mainstream Japanese retail.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance Pay now allows users to spend USDT directly at merchants on Japan's PayPay QR payment network, extending stablecoin payments into mainstream Japanese retail.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance Pay now allows users to spend USDT directly at merchants on Japan's PayPay QR payment network, extending stablecoin payments into mainstream Japanese retail.

updates.title_zh: 日本最大支付网络通过Binance Pay向加密货币敞开大门
updates.title_en: Japan’s biggest payment network opens its doors for crypto via Binance Pay
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：该集成通过HIVEX跨境支付网络实现，仅限完成身份验证的海外访客，日本居民不可用；支持超100种加密货币，商户以日元结算，退款金额可能因汇率和外汇点差而异，并存在部分商户不支持等排除项。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: the integration runs through the HIVEX cross-border payment network, is restricted to identity-verified overseas visitors and excludes Japan residents; it supports 100+ cryptocurrencies, merchants receive yen, refund amounts can vary with exchange rates and FX spreads, and exclusions apply to some merchant categories.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance Pay通过HIVEX接入日本PayPay QR支付网络，符合条件的海外访客可使用加密货币在参与商户处付款，商户收到日元；日本居民及部分商户类型被排除。
updates.current_state_en: Binance Pay is live on Japan's PayPay QR payment network via HIVEX, enabling eligible overseas visitors to pay with crypto at participating merchants while merchants receive yen; Japan residents and certain merchant categories are excluded.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: PayPay launched Binance Pay through HIVEX on September 30, letting eligible overseas visitors pay with crypto at participating Japanese offline stores while merchants receive yen.
updates.detailed_summary_en: PayPay launched Binance Pay through HIVEX on September 30, letting eligible overseas visitors pay with crypto at participating Japanese offline stores while merchants receive yen.
